sloka: ततस्ताभ्यां प्रमुक्तेन शरवर्षेण भास्वता ।शरबद्धमिवाभाति द्वितीयं भास्वदम्बरम् ।। ६.१०९.२३ ।।
transliteration: tatastābhyāṁ pramuktena śaravarṣeṇa bhāsvatā ।śarabaddhamivābhāti dvitīyaṁ bhāsvadambaram ।। 6.109.23 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the arrows in the sky released by Rama, even Ravana released arrows up to the sky. With the arrows released by both of them, the space became resplendent and by the network of arrows covering it seemed like another sky.
